snippet.title: Halloween Decoration Sandbox | Now With VR Support
snippet.description:
Patch 1.2.1 Beta is now live.
Included Features:
- Virtual Reality Headset support (Oculus Devices).
- 4 New Project Light designs.

- Tons of bug fixes.
- Over a dozen new decorations.
- Improved fog machine performance.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1438750/Halloween_Decoration_Sandbox

https://twitter.com/HalloweenSandbx
https://techskullgames.weebly.com/
